items.title: R.C.H. Smith Interview, 1975-10-02
items.q: I can remember hearing a very tasteful recording years ago by Buck Clayton ... which they just played it very straightforward and honestly and I think that influenced me

ctx.x: is that what you're talking about that type of sugar blues

yeah I don't think I didn't do that I played it I can remember hearing a very tasteful recording years ago by Buck Clayton Buck Clayton and Don Bias little quartet or quintet recording of sugar blues which they just played it very straightforward and honestly and I think that influenced me and I think I preferred to play it that way which of course would be a great disappointment to an audience that wanted to hear a lot of wah-wah rickety-tick razzmatazz things like things like Wabash Blues would come up well you…
did you have any idols when you were coming up
